content.text: This gene signature (SPINK2, CYTL1, STMN1, LYL1, LAPTM4B, SMIM24/C11orf21) is classic for early hematopoietic progenitor/stem cells (HSPCs) — SPINK2 and CYTL1 are well-known markers of CD34+ progenitors, LYL1 is a hematopoietic stem/progenitor transcription factor, and STMN1 indicates high proliferative activity. This combination is rarely seen in mature PBMC lineages and strongly suggests a small contaminating population of CD34+ hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells within the PBMC sample.
